items.title: Same Expertise, Different Wrapper: CHDG Builds on Dynamic Hedging Legacy
items.summary: Calamos Active Hedged Equity ETF’s dynamic hedging approach is designed to capitalize on changing markets and volatility in ways that static approaches can’t. Senior Co-Portfolio Manager Dave O’Donohue speaks to the advantages that CHDG brings.

items.title: Beyond the Coupon: How to Evaluate a Growing Autocallable ETF Category
items.summary: Autocallable ETFs are expanding rapidly within the derivative-income market. Head of ETFs Matt Kaufman outlines seven key questions advisors should ask when evaluating these ETFs, highlighting Calamos's CAIE and CAIQ as disciplined, transparent options built on volatility-targeted, laddered index structures.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Calamos Investment Team Outlooks, July 2026
items.summary: “Markets never move in a straight line, even when they are trending upward over time,” notes Founder and Global CIO John P. Calamos, Sr. in his July introduction to the Investment Team Outlooks. Amid record convertible issuance and broadening equity leadership, he emphasizes vigilance around Fed policy, geopolitical risk, and portfolio rebalancing.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Running at a Steady Pace as Bonds Limp Along
items.summary: CMNIX outperformed bonds in Q2 and year to date, driven by gains across convertible arbitrage, hedged equity, merger arbitrage, and SPAC arbitrage. Record convertible issuance, including Alphabet's landmark deal, and a favorable merger environment support the fund’s multi-strategy, market-agnostic approach to steady performance.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Global Markets: Fundamentals Have the Floor
items.summary: Global equities rallied in Q2 2026, led by emerging markets and earnings-driven growth stocks. The Calamos global team sees fundamentals, not momentum, powering markets, and diversifies across secular, cyclical, and defensive growth themes, including AI infrastructure, healthcare, and emerging-market consumption. Inflation and geopolitical risks remain key watch points.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: In a Tightrope Market, Discipline Is the Balancing Pole
items.summary: Markets in 2026 hover between resilient earnings and narrow, momentum-driven gains, with valuations near dot-com-era extremes. SROIX favors diversified, quality companies with strong balance sheets and reasonable valuations across sectors and geographies, positioning for resilience when momentum inevitably reverses and market participation broadens.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Staying Agile Pays Off
items.summary: Elevated rates and narrow, whipsawing market breadth continue to align well with Calamos Hedged Equity Fund’s dynamic approach. The team rolled its base hedge to December 2027, targeting 60%–65% upside and 35%–40% downside participation, while actively trading around the edges to enhance returns.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Ask for a Pony, Get a Ferrari: Good Times for Global Convertibles
items.summary: Calamos Global Convertible Fund (CXGCX) gained 14.5% in Q2, outperforming both the FTSE Global Convertible Index and MSCI World Index. Record convertible issuance, led by Alphabet's $19.3 billion deal, created opportunities to rebalance. The team remains optimistic but cautious given geopolitical uncertainty and late-cycle risks ahead.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Broadening Earnings Growth, Broadening Opportunities
items.summary: The mid-cycle expansion continues as the energy shock fades, with inflation moderating gradually. AI infrastructure drove earnings, but leadership is broadening into financials, industrials, and health care. Calamos Growth and Income Fund outperformed the S&P 500, rebalancing toward a more diversified, risk-aware positioning.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Goooaal! Fundamental Momentum and Small Caps Win in 2Q
items.summary: Small caps delivered standout Q2 returns, with the Russell 2000 outpacing large caps by 635 basis points. Calamos Timpani funds significantly outperformed peers by targeting companies with sustainably fast, underestimated earnings growth—a fundamental momentum approach that the team expects to reward investors going forward.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Ceasefire on Paper, Tension Below: Fixed Income in an Uncertain Summer
items.summary: Geopolitical tensions and a Fed pivot toward deliberate opacity are driving rate volatility, while credit fundamentals remain resilient. The Calamos fixed income team is maintaining a quality bias, monitoring record issuance volumes for spread pressure, and holding to a thesis of long-term yield-curve steepening.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Picking Our Spots in a Record Convertible Market
items.summary: Record convertible issuance and AI infrastructure tailwinds are creating compelling opportunities. Calamos Convertible Fund leverages active management and bottom-up selection to pursue growth companies with favorable risk-reward asymmetry, while convertible structures that offer downside mitigation provide resilience amid persistent geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainty.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Everything Shaken, Little Really Stirred
items.summary: AI infrastructure dominance and a hawkish Fed are reshaping the investment landscape. Calamos Phineus Long/Short Fund manager Michael Grant sees broadening but concentrated market leadership, expects inflation to surprise to the downside, and anticipates a topping process through autumn as positioning risk and midterm election uncertainty intensify.

items.title: Demystifying Calamos' Protected Bitcoin ETFs
items.summary: Bitcoin's explosive growth has captured attention worldwide. Despite its surging demand, its extreme volatility has made many investors skeptical. Now, leveraging our expertise in risk management, we’ve created a suite of Protected Bitcoin ETFs with customizable downside protection up to 100%. But how does it work?

items.title: Fi360 Ranks Calamos Funds in Top Quartile
items.summary: The Fi360 Fiduciary Score is a peer percentile ranking of an investment against a set of quantitative due diligence criteria selected to reflect prudent fiduciary management.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: A Case for Systematic Protection Amid Market & Political Uncertainty
items.summary: A year ago, we launched CPSL to address a critical downside vulnerability in the market. As a fund of funds, CPSL equally allocates capital across 12 Calamos S&P 500 Structured Alt Protection ETFs with staggered monthly outcome periods. This design enabled CPSL to provide downside risk mitigation during the February to April tariff selloff, which sent the S&P 500 tumbling -18.75%, while capturing upside gains in the subsequent recovery.

items.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
items.title: Rebalance Don’t Retreat: Alternative Strategies to Help You Stay Invested
items.summary: Calamos alternative offerings are designed to navigate volatility, with the goal of providing a steadier ride through choppy equity markets. In this post, we highlight two of our innovative solutions—which can work independently or in tandem to help address investor needs.

items.title: Protected Bitcoin ETFs – The “Double-Dip” Trade and Buying Beyond Day One
items.summary: Discover how Calamos Protected Bitcoin ETFs’ "double-dip" trade strategy may allow investors to potentially capitalize on performance gaps that emerge when the Bitcoin and ETF returns do not move in lockstep. Learn why buying beyond day one might present a compelling alternative for investors looking to capture additional returns and reduce risk, while maintaining Bitcoin exposure.
